moments.title: Halloween Weekend Frights
moments.blurb: The spookiest weekend of the year is upon us, with Halloween falling on Friday, October 31st, and events running across the UK until November 1st.

angles.name: General Halloween
angles.copy: Who's ready for a frightfully good Halloween weekend? From theme park scare fests to family-friendly fun, the UK is going all out for October 31st!

angles.name: Spooky Plans
angles.copy: Got your costume ready? Halloween is just days away! What are your spooky plans for Friday night?

moments.title: Bonfire Night Approaches
moments.blurb: Bonfire Night, commemorating the Gunpowder Plot, falls on Thursday, November 5th, with firework displays and bonfires happening across the UK on the day and the surrounding weekend.

angles.name: Remember, Remember
angles.copy: Remember, remember the 5th of November! Bonfire Night is next Thursday, with fireworks and bonfires lighting up skies across the UK. What's your favourite display?

angles.name: Guy Fawkes
angles.copy: Guy Fawkes Night is almost here! Who's looking forward to wrapping up warm and watching some spectacular fireworks?

angles.name: Top Fixtures

moments.title: Blossoms Top Album Chart
